Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644', standard_relation = '=', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
